thought.text: Swagger is served at `/api/v1/swagger` (301→200). Let me find the school/teacher super-admin endpoints and verify the school creation.

reasoning_content: The swagger endpoint is working (301 → 200, 3106 bytes). Let's use it to find the school/teacher endpoints.

action.command: cd /workspace && docker compose exec -T backend wget -qO- "http://127.0.0.1:4000/api/v1/swagger" -O /tmp/swg 2>&1 | tail -1; docker cp workspace-backend-1:/tmp/swg /tmp/swg 2>/dev/null; echo "--- swagger HTML size:"; wc -c /tmp/swg; echo "--- find the JSON spec URL:"; grep -oE '(url|spec|json)[^"]*"\s*[:=]\s*"[^"]+"' /tmp/swg | head; grep -oE '/api/v1/[a-z0-9/_-]+\.json' /tmp/swg | head
